verdicts.reason: Both break the original's key motif: the shoe sits well off-centre from the lime circle, so they read as two separate shapes. Both also put the NEW VIDEO badge to the left of the logo on one row, which buries the brand mark, and the headline breaks awkwardly, leaving 'marathons' alone on the second line. A keeps the whole circle on the canvas but leaves a dead gap between the copy and the shoe. B pushes the shoe and circle into the bottom-right corner, where the circle runs off the right and bottom edges and the composition looks lopsided, so A is marginally less broken.
